RescueReport.title: Rescue Report
RescueReport.description: Rescue report ticket representing a stray animal in distress.

ticketNumber.description: Unique identifier for this rescue ticket, e.g. PWG-2026-001

animalType.description: The type of animal in distress, e.g. Dog, Cat, Cow

breed.description: The detected or presumed breed or mix

healthStatus.description: Limb condition, injury, mange status or other symptoms

description.description: Detailed notes on distress state and context

location.description: Physical location description, landmark or street

imageUrl.description: Image link of the animal in distress

reporterName.description: The name of the reporting civilian

reporterContact.description: Contact phone number of the reporter

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when the report was created

AdoptionRequest.title: Adoption Request
AdoptionRequest.description: Applicant questionnaire to adopt or foster a rescued pet.

animalId.description: The ID of the pet chosen for adoption

animalName.description: The name of the animal, e.g. Buddy, Luna

applicantName.description: The name of the adoptive applicant

visitDate.description: Scheduled date for adoption shelter visit

message.description: Introduction or motivation from the applicant

status.description: Verification status of the adoption application

/rescueReports/{ticketNumber}.description: Active stray animal distress logs tracked on dispatch coordinate maps.

/adoptionRequests/{requestId}.description: Adoption and foster applications from civilian visitors.
